source_title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP Notifies Stockholders of an Investigation into the Fairness of the Acquisition of Priority Technology Holdings, Inc.
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The following statement is being issued by Levi & Korsinsky, LLP:
To: All Persons or Entities who purchased Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. (" PRTH" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: PRTH ) stock prior to September 18, 2026 .
You are hereby notified that Levi & Korsinsky, LLP has commenced an investigation into the fairness of the acquisition of PRTH by its largest stockholder, Chairman, and CEO, Thomas C. Priore . As a result of the merger, PRTH stockholders are expected to receive only $8.05 per share in cash in exchange for each share of common stock.

or contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. either via email at [email protected] or by telephone at (212) 363-7500. There is no cost or obligation to you .
The PRTH merger investigation concerns whether PRTH's Board of Directors have harmed stockholders by failing to maximize the Company's merger price and whether all material facts have been properly disclosed to stockholders.
Levi & Korsinsky is a nationally recognized firm with offices in New York, Connecticut, California, and Washington, D.C. The firm's attorneys have extensive expertise in prosecuting securities litigation involving financial fraud , representing investors throughout the nation in securities lawsuits, and have recovered hundreds of millions of dollars for aggrieved shareholders .
